name: Agentic Diagnostics

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: go.sum

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cache/go-build
            ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('**/go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-

      - name: Run tests
        run: go test ./...

      - name: Harden runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@20cf305ff2072d973412fa9b1e3a4f227bda3c76
        with:
          allowed-endpoints: "api.github.com,api.openai.com"
          egress-policy: block
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          disable-telemetry: true
          disable-sudo: true
          disable-sudo-and-containers: true
          disable-file-monitoring: true

  validate-spec:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Validate Safe Inputs JSON schema
        uses: dsanders11/json-schema-validate-action@v1.4.0
        with:
          schema: docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json
          files: |
            docs/src/content/docs/reference/*.yaml
            docs/src/content/docs/reference/*.yml

          all-errors: true
